paras.text: The Code 11.59 by Audemars Piguet Selfwinding presents an 18-carat white gold case complemented by a smoked blue sunburst lacquered dial and a black rubber-coated strap.

imgs.alt: Standup image of the watch Selfwinding

paras.text: 18-carat white gold case, bezel, lugs and caseback, double glareproofed sapphire crystal and caseback.
Smoked blue lacquered dial with sunburst pattern, white gold applied hour-markers and hands, black lacquered inner bezel.
Black rubber-coated strap with 18-carat white gold pin buckle.
